stats_iashark.title: IASHARK stats
stats_iashark.method_help: Every figure counts official matches already played, friendlies excluded: 2 years of its league for a team (official matches for a national team), 2 years for a league, 3 years for a referee. The margin shows the range the true figure falls in 95 times out of 100. Under 15 matches (30 for a referee, a league or a half-time case), nothing is shown.
stats_iashark.source: Source: the IASHARK archive of matches already played.
stats_iashark.first_title: The first goal in their past matches
stats_iashark.first_sub: Their past: this is not the chance of scoring first in this match.
stats_iashark.slots_note: Over 15 minutes, differences between two teams are mostly down to chance: the league row is the benchmark.
stats_iashark.ht_sub: How the team’s matches ended, by the half-time score
stats_iashark.range_note: In brackets, the margin: the true figure lies within it 95 times out of 100.

stats_iashark.fold_sub_until: Worked out from matches played up to {date}
stats_iashark.ref_note: “Expected for his matches”: the average of each competition and season he refereed in, European cups and national teams included. A referee takes charge of fewer matches than a team plays, so he is followed over 3 years. The league profile below covers only 2 years of {league}: the two figures can differ.
stats_iashark.ref_margin_help: The referee’s margins are wider than the others: three figures are compared at once, and together they must be right 95 times out of 100. A gap is only written when the expected figure falls outside the margin.
stats_iashark.ref_meter: On the bars, the dot is his average and the white line the expected figure.
stats_iashark.range_note_bars: In brackets, and as a thin line on the bars, the margin: the true figure lies within it 95 times out of 100.
